report.caveat: Factual before/after comparison. Event metrics cover retained events; compaction is not negative activity. Causal impact is stored direct effects with a bounded graph, not invented narrative.

checks.label: no negative wealth
checks.detail: No person ever holds negative wealth (every payment path caps at the payer's actual balance).

checks.label: living index consistency
checks.detail: Living/active indices exactly match canonical person/body life state.

checks.label: household consistency
checks.detail: Every household membership is reciprocal and contains only living people.

checks.label: currency conservation
checks.detail: Total currency (wealth + carried coin items) never increases between probes, and only ever decreases by the explicit, tallied supply-cost sink.

checks.label: inventory holder agreement
checks.detail: Every item's holderId agrees with exactly one person's inventory list (no item held by nobody it claims, no item held by two people).

checks.label: dead do not work
checks.detail: A dead person never holds an active work-type goal or a non-empty plan.

checks.label: haul cargo conserved
checks.detail: An in-transit haul task's cargo item, if it materialized one, is actually held by the claimant; delivered/carried never exceed the requested quantity.

checks.label: ownership references real entities
checks.detail: An item's ownerId, when set, always names a person that actually exists.

checks.label: spendable currency is real
checks.detail: Spendable wealth never falls while total currency (wealth + coins) holds steady — that signature means money is being converted into a form nothing can spend, not conserved.

checks.label: no inert currency growth
checks.detail: No non-player person ever holds a physical coins item — every NPC economic action reads Person.wealth, never a coin Item, so a held coin item is dead money.

checks.label: no false theft belief
checks.detail: An item legitimately assigned to an open haul task and carried by its authorized claimant never generates a missing/stolen belief in its owner's mind.

checks.label: locality of commitments
checks.detail: Commitments remain reachable and local to home; immediate water errands remain local to their fixed decision origin.

checks.label: Duplicate item locations
checks.detail: An item cannot have both holder and ground position (or holder and container).

checks.label: Knowledge provenance shape
checks.detail: Confidence, time and sources represented; not proof every legacy premise is epistemically valid.

checks.label: Invalid event actors
checks.detail: Retained event actor references resolve.

checks.label: Full resource conservation
checks.detail: Stock/haul/currency checks are configured. No complete material balance for all transformations exists.

checks.label: Impossible movement
checks.detail: No continuous trajectory proof in this sampled inspector.

checks.label: stuck agent
checks.detail: Existing anomaly detector over retained history; absence alone cannot prove full-window coverage.

checks.label: goal churn
checks.detail: Existing anomaly detector over retained history; absence alone cannot prove full-window coverage.

checks.label: event spam
checks.detail: Existing anomaly detector over retained history; absence alone cannot prove full-window coverage.

checks.label: unresolved conflict loop
checks.detail: Existing anomaly detector over retained history; absence alone cannot prove full-window coverage.

checks.label: Runaway conversation loops
checks.detail: Event spam checks cover repeated event types. A dedicated conversation-cycle invariant is not yet represented.

checks.label: Determinism
checks.detail: Run the isolated replay / continuity check.

checks.label: Save/load continuity
checks.detail: Run the isolated replay / continuity check.

checks.label: Simulation performance
checks.detail: Last fixed 0.15 s headless step: 130.46 ms; configured budget 100 ms, not an FPS claim.

scenario.title: Ordinary settlement
scenario.description: Authored Ashford reference settlement, generated from seed; all inhabitants autonomous.
invariants: Ordinary canonical actions only after setup

checks.label: no negative wealth
checks.detail: No person ever holds negative wealth (every payment path caps at the payer's actual balance).

checks.label: living index consistency
checks.detail: Living/active indices exactly match canonical person/body life state.

checks.label: household consistency
checks.detail: Every household membership is reciprocal and contains only living people.

checks.label: currency conservation
checks.detail: Total currency (wealth + carried coin items) never increases between probes, and only ever decreases by the explicit, tallied supply-cost sink.

checks.label: inventory holder agreement
checks.detail: Every item's holderId agrees with exactly one person's inventory list (no item held by nobody it claims, no item held by two people).

checks.label: dead do not work
checks.detail: A dead person never holds an active work-type goal or a non-empty plan.

checks.label: haul cargo conserved
checks.detail: An in-transit haul task's cargo item, if it materialized one, is actually held by the claimant; delivered/carried never exceed the requested quantity.

checks.label: ownership references real entities
checks.detail: An item's ownerId, when set, always names a person that actually exists.

checks.label: spendable currency is real
checks.detail: Spendable wealth never falls while total currency (wealth + coins) holds steady — that signature means money is being converted into a form nothing can spend, not conserved.

checks.label: no inert currency growth
checks.detail: No non-player person ever holds a physical coins item — every NPC economic action reads Person.wealth, never a coin Item, so a held coin item is dead money.

checks.label: no false theft belief
checks.detail: An item legitimately assigned to an open haul task and carried by its authorized claimant never generates a missing/stolen belief in its owner's mind.

checks.label: locality of commitments
checks.detail: Commitments remain reachable and local to home; immediate water errands remain local to their fixed decision origin.

checks.label: Duplicate item locations
checks.detail: An item cannot have both holder and ground position (or holder and container).

checks.label: Knowledge provenance shape
checks.detail: Confidence, time and sources represented; not proof every legacy premise is epistemically valid.

checks.label: Invalid event actors
checks.detail: Retained event actor references resolve.

checks.label: Full resource conservation
checks.detail: Stock/haul/currency checks are configured. No complete material balance for all transformations exists.

checks.label: Impossible movement
checks.detail: No continuous trajectory proof in this sampled inspector.

checks.label: stuck agent
checks.detail: Existing anomaly detector over retained history; absence alone cannot prove full-window coverage.

checks.label: goal churn
checks.detail: Existing anomaly detector over retained history; absence alone cannot prove full-window coverage.

checks.label: event spam
checks.detail: Existing anomaly detector over retained history; absence alone cannot prove full-window coverage.

checks.label: unresolved conflict loop
checks.detail: Existing anomaly detector over retained history; absence alone cannot prove full-window coverage.

checks.label: Runaway conversation loops
checks.detail: Event spam checks cover repeated event types. A dedicated conversation-cycle invariant is not yet represented.

checks.label: Determinism
checks.detail: Run the isolated replay / continuity check.

checks.label: Save/load continuity
checks.detail: Run the isolated replay / continuity check.

checks.label: Simulation performance
checks.detail: Last fixed 0.15 s headless step: 130.46 ms; configured budget 100 ms, not an FPS claim.
